subject.title: [Bug]: Control UI header logo/icon not displaying after 2026.3.24 update

question: Should Control UI support hard-refresh public assets on arbitrary unconfigured route prefixes, or only on root, known app routes, configured basePath, and the internal `/__openclaw__/` namespace?
rationale: The source still preserves 404 behavior for arbitrary prefixed static assets, and changing that behavior affects the gateway static-file safety contract rather than being a purely mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Support only explicit routes
options.body: Keep arbitrary prefixed static paths as 404s, but ensure root, known deep routes, configured basePath, and `/__openclaw__/` public assets are generated or rewritten correctly.

options.title: Support broader prefixes
options.body: Add a constrained gateway mapping for known shipped public assets under arbitrary prefixes, with tests proving unknown static files still 404.

options.title: Reject remaining route-prefix work
options.body: Document arbitrary non-tab prefixes as unsupported and close the linked fork PR as obsolete after confirming root and configured-basePath behavior are sufficient.

recommendation.title: Support only explicit routes
recommendation.body: Keep arbitrary prefixed static paths as 404s, but ensure root, known deep routes, configured basePath, and `/__openclaw__/` public assets are generated or rewritten correctly.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal for gateway static serving, namespaced assets, and route contract decisions is steipete.
